claims.text: The rider's own instruction in the chat log asked the driver to stop at IMM first, and the driver agreed. That is a rider-requested additional stop on its face, and it is the driver's best exculpatory hook under POL-RD-04. But the clause requires the gps_trace to corroborate the instruction: the vehicle must pass within 200 m of the waypoint named by chat_message.waypoint_hint. The platform's own derived waypoint_approach block shows the nearest fix to the IMM hint (1.3348, 103.7466) was 3088.34 m away, and within_threshold is false. The instruction therefore did not cause the measured excess, POL-RD-04 does not apply, no distance is excluded, and the deviation is decided on the trace as measured under POL-RD-01 and POL-RD-02.

The deviation is established on this trip's own trace. The governing field is gps_trace.trace_distance_km, which is 23.79 km, against an optimal_distance_km of 18.3 km stored on the trip record at booking. Excess is 5.49 km, which is 30.0% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 tests pass: the excess exceeds 20% of optimal and exceeds 0.8 km absolute. The rider's claim that the trip was 23.79 km for 18.3 km is therefore correct on the trace figure, and the trip_record.actual_distance_km of 23.8 km is a rounded convenience copy that may not be cited for the threshold test.

The driver's traffic excuse carries no weight. The bundle holds a traffic_advisory artifact for this trip, EV-ADVIS-02856-01, but its admissibility status is MISSING, its payload is null and its weight_multiplier is 0.0, with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT: no advisory covers the Blk 12 Telok Blangah Cres corridor in this window. POL-RD-03 requires an advisory record naming a road the optimal route traverses with an overlapping validity window; that comparison cannot be run on the record, so POL-RD-03 is unavailable and the assertion is discarded under POL-RD-08. The driver's counterparty statement asserts only that the rider asked for IMM, which is a rider-instruction point, not a traffic point, and it too fails on the trace.

The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02, and the fare model is METERED, so the clause runs. Charged total is 31.13. Recomputed fare on the booked optimal route is ((3.80 + 0.75 x 18.3 + 0.28 x 24.7) x 1.0 surge) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP + 0 waiting time - 0 promo = 25.2410. Refund = 31.13 - 25.2410 = 5.8890, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05, which is 5.90. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and well below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of 5.90. The surge multiplier was read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, which is 1.0.

No ERP or surcharge correction is due. The fare breakdown carries zero ERP gantries and zero tolls, and the airport surcharge line is 0.0 on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport, so there is no phantom line to refund under POL-RD-09(4) and no off-route pass-through to add on top of the POL-RD-02 figure. The rider's payment_status is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.0, so the present state stands until the refund issues.

The driver's profile does not rescue him and does not uplift the remedy. POL-RD-06 is consulted because POL-RD-01 records a MATERIAL deviation (30.0% exceeds 50%? No - it does not; the excess is 30.0%, below the 50% and 8.0 km materiality gates, so the deviation is established but not material). Even on the POL-RD-06 test, driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 and 0/408 is 0.0, far below the 3-flag and 0.05 ratio thresholds, so no repeat pattern is established and no FULL_REFUND uplift or conduct referral follows. I note the driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d of 2 is context only under POL-GEN-01 and grounds nothing here.

The rider's profile does not weaken the claim. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 1 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, so the POL-RD-08 corroboration trigger (4 or more claims with 1 or fewer substantiated) is not met, and no extra corroboration beyond the gps_trace is required. The rider has shown both limbs of POL-RD-08: the trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry trip_id TRP-02856 and the same pickup timestamp, and the excess meets the POL-RD-01 threshold on an unimpaired trace. The burden shifted to the driver and he has pointed to no clause that discharges it.

The trace is clean for policy purposes and no escalation trigger fires. The gps_trace has 187 fixes at a 10 s interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps and a max gap of 0 s, so POL-RD-07(a) to (c) are not met and the trace is not impaired. The trip identifiers match across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown, the timestamps run forward, the refund of 5.90 is far below the SGD 150.00 ceiling and below charged_total, and the only missing artifact is the advisory, which no party cited as an exculpatory record and which is therefore a gap in the bundle rather than a POL-RD-10(5) contradiction. The case is decidable and should be ruled, not escalated.

Refund = 31.13 - 25.2410 = 5.8890, rounded up to SGD 5.90. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and well below the 90% full-refund share, so it is a partial refund of SGD 5.90.

Pass-through lines (POL-RD-09). There are zero ERP gantries, zero tolls and no airport surcharge, so there is no off-route or phantom charge to refund separately, and nothing is added on top of the POL-RD-02 figure.

Evidence quality. The GPS trace is not impaired for policy purposes: 187 fixes at a 10 s interval, 100% coverage, zero gaps. It therefore carries the deviation on its own under POL-RD-07. Confidence is 0.95, above the 0.70 floor, so this is decided rather than escalated. The monetary effect (SGD 5.90) is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically. This ruling is addressed to both parties. The trip ran 23.79 km door-to-door on the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02856, trace_distance_km 23.79) against a booked optimal route of 18.3 km on the trip record (EV-TRIP-02856). The excess is 5.49 km, or 30.0% of optimal, which passes both POL-RD-01 tests (more than 20% and more than 0.8 km), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. It is not a MATERIAL deviation (below the 50% and 8.0 km gates), so no POL-RD-06 uplift or conduct referral applies.

DRIVER'S IMM POINT. The driver says the rider asked for IMM and points to the chat. That instruction is real: the chat log (EV-CHAT-02856) carries the rider's message 'stop at IMM first please' at 15:33:19 and the driver's 'ok'. But POL-RD-04 requires the GPS trace to corroborate it, by the vehicle passing within 200 m of the waypoint named by chat_message.waypoint_hint (IMM, 1.3348/103.7466). The platform's derived waypoint_approach block shows the nearest fix was 3,088.34 m away and within_threshold is false, so the driver never went to IMM. The rider's complaint on this point is correct. Under POL-RD-14 the request did not cause the measured excess: POL-RD-04 does not apply, no distance is excluded, and the deviation is decided on the trace as measured. This is not the contradiction in POL-RD-10(7) - a request made and a route that did not follow it are consistent.

TRAFFIC EXCUSE. The bundle holds no advisory covering this trip: EV-ADVIS-02856-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. Any external-cause assertion therefore carries no weight (POL-RD-03 unavailable, POL-RD-08, POL-RD-13).

REFUND (POL-RD-02, fare model METERED). Recomputed fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 18.3 + 0.28 x 24.7) x 1.0 surge) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP + 0 waiting time - 0 promo = 25.2410. Charged total was 31.13 (EV-FARE-02856). Refund = 31.13 - 25.2410 = 5.8890, rounded UP to SGD 5.90. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and below the 90% full-refund share of charged_total, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 5.90. The surge multiplier of 1.0 was read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier.

PASS-THROUGH LINES (POL-RD-09). The fare breakdown carries zero ERP gantries, zero tolls and no airport surcharge, so there is no off-route or phantom line to refund and nothing to add on top of the POL-RD-02 figure.

PROFILES. The rider's profile (deviation_claims_60d = 1) does not trigger the extra-corroboration requirement under POL-RD-08. The driver's profile does not help him: deviation_flags_90d is 0 over 408 completed trips, so no repeat pattern, no FULL_REFUND uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) referral. No billing-integrity, false-arrival or no-show referral fires.

NO ESCALATION. The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes (187 fixes, 10 s interval, 100% coverage, zero gaps, max gap 0 s), so POL-RD-07(a)-(c) do not fire; trip identifiers match; timestamps run forward; and the refund is far below the SGD 150.00 ceiling. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires and the case is ruled, not escalated. Because the monetary effect of SGD 5.90 is at or below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, the provisional ruling is executed automatically under POL-GEN-05, subject to the appeal route in POL-GEN-04. Confidence 0.92, resting on artifacts all at weight 1.0 (two discarded pre-pass claims failed only on non-disclosure of the missing advisory's issue code).
